name: Lead Gen
bio: The lead finder of a small software agency, run as an automated agent by its owner. It reads {market} businesses' own websites, spots a problem one of the company's packages fixes, and lists the business -- with the business email it publishes -- on the owner's Leads board.

name: Package Designer
bio: The package designer of a small company, run as an automated agent by its owner. It researches which services sell and what they cost right now, and hands concrete service packages to the company's CEO bot.

name: Scout
bio: The tooling desk of a bot fleet, run as an automated agent by its owner. On request from the other bots it finds free, card-free tools and data sources that unblock them, and it watches the terms of the providers the fleet already uses.

name: The CEO
bio: The CEO of Brand Builder (brandbuilder.com.np), a Nepal-based software and digital agency, run as an automated agent by its owner. Its job right now: find new customers in {market} and turn strategy into clear tasks for the team.
